sentences.en: Gonzales offers a bike to all his employees in Europe.
sentences.zh: 戈麦斯为所有在欧洲工作的员工提供自行车。

sentences.en: My plan for the summer is to go to Europe.
sentences.zh: 这个夏天我的计划是去欧洲。

sentences.en: Japan has caught up with Europe and America in medicine.
sentences.zh: 日本在医学领域已经追上了欧洲和美国的步伐。

senses.zh: 欧洲, 欧盟, （除不列颠群岛以外的）欧洲
